scenario: Process server Arthur Pendelton completes and files the return of service for a third-party summons served on David C. Miller in a federal commercial dispute.

values.source_line: This action is being litigated in the United States District Court for the Northern District of California.
The summons issue date shown today is 10/12/2023.
The plaintiff in this proceeding is Apex Logistics LLC.
The named defendant is Summit Freight Inc.
The third-party complaint names David C. Miller as the third-party defendant.

values.source_line: The third-party defendant's name and address is David C. Miller, 742 Evergreen Terrace, Oakland, CA 94611.
The third-party plaintiff is Defendant Summit Freight Inc.

values.source_line: Counsel of record for plaintiff is Elena Rostova, Esq., Rostova Litigation Group, 201 Mission Street, Suite 800, San Francisco, CA 94105.
